message: So there I was, enjoying a cozy evening at home when the power decided to take a little vacation. Naturally, I thought I was prepared—until I realized my flashlight batteries were dead and my phone was at 5%! 🤦‍♀️ After a minor panic dance, I fished out my trusty power bank, and then it hit me: I had a whole cupboard full of snacks but no way to see them! 😂 Lesson learned—next time, I’m stocking up on batteries and brightening up my pantry. What’s your go-to tip for staying comfy during a blackout?
